changeSummary: Added QualityBlockTemporalRuntimeEvidenceGuard and a machine-readable temporal_runtime_evidence_contract. The authoritative temporal sequence now starts only from the persisted, reflection-synchronized benchmark scene.

The runtime guard captures the physical-lighting SHA-256 before the sequence and revalidates it in MainCamera.onPreCull once for every required temporal Camera.Render. A missing/extra MainCamera render or lighting drift fails closed.

The guard resets QualityBlockFilmicTonemap telemetry after the three stills, then requires render, native-4K, filmic-tonemap, HDR-source and LDR-destination invocation counts all to equal the temporal frame count with zero fallback blits.

The temporal runtime receipt is SHA-256-bound to the persisted scene, temporal manifest, temporal receipt, prepared temporal binding, reflection completion receipt and asynchronous reflection wait proof. It records zero automatic visual points and UNSCORED_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket wraps prepared temporal capture in Begin/CompleteAndSeal with Abort on failure, so runtime evidence is generated in the canonical packet rather than as an optional side path.

QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA now requires the latest temporal runtime receipt before reviewed evidence can reach the core numeric gate. QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate already invokes this reviewed-evidence validator internally, including direct runner/reflection calls.

QualityBlockFilmicTonemap now counts HDR-source and non-HDR-destination observations per invocation. Still-image HDR QA was strengthened from last-frame-only format evidence to exactly three HDR-source plus three LDR-destination observations for hero/oblique/grazing.
selfAudit: The first temporal runtime contract commit misspelled requireFilmicTonemapForEveryTemporalFrame as requireFilmicTonmapForEveryTemporalFrame. This would have made the new contract validator fail closed immediately; the field was corrected before finalizing the run.

The first runtime guard version checked HDR/LDR format only on the final temporal invocation, matching the prior still QA pattern. This was insufficient to prove every frame. The filmic component was extended with per-invocation HDR-source/LDR-destination counters, and both temporal and still QA now require exact per-frame/per-still totals.

Source inspection confirms the existing prepared temporal capture already writes actual 3840x2160 frames/crops and a no-rebuild reflection binding; this run did not duplicate that functionality. It adds the missing runtime lighting/display-transform proof around that existing path.

sourceVerification.reasonRuntimeReceiptNotGenerated: No Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/editor execution is available in this source-only run. The receipt is deliberately generated only by real guarded Camera.Render execution.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability 5: prevents temporal evidence from being accepted if frame count, lighting state or filmic display-transform execution differs across the sequence. Actual shimmer, aliasing and LOD pop remain pixel-review only.
Lighting/shadows/reflections 15: temporal frames cannot silently use a different SummerSun/sky/ambient/shadow fingerprint from the synchronized evidence state.
Cinematic image quality 5: temporal evidence must use the intended HDR-to-LDR filmic path on every frame, so exposure/tonemap review is not mixed with raw/fallback frames.

Material/PBR physical plausibility 20: reflection/specular behavior reviewed across temporal motion is evidence-bound to the same physical lighting state; no material points are awarded without pixels.
Automatic Visual Fidelity impact: 0 points. These are provenance and fail-closed runtime requirements, not observed image quality.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and real native capture. At first runner availability, run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. The first acceptance criteria are: no compile errors; exactly one guarded MainCamera pre-cull lighting check per temporal frame; identical physical-lighting SHA-256 for all temporal culls; HDR-source count == LDR-destination count == filmic/native-4K render count == required temporal frame count; fallback count == 0; and valid SHA-256 bindings to the same prepared scene/reflection/temporal evidence. Then inspect the actual 100% temporal crops for shimmer, aliasing and LOD pop before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
